cues: Let's see how to add an event in Wedding Yantra, and run it from start to finish.
Open Events.
Your upcoming events are here, month by month.
Tap Calendar to see every booking by date.
Red dots mean a busy day.
When a client accepts your quote, the event is made for you.
To add one yourself, tap New event.
First, choose the client.
If they're new, tap New and type their name and number.
Give the event a name, and choose the type.
Add the booking value and the main venue.
Now add each function, like Mehendi, Sangeet and the wedding, with its date and time.
Check everything, and tap Create event.
This is your event.
Every function, with its date, time and venue, is in one place.
Tap Choose the team.
Tick who works this event, add their role and the time to reach, and tap Save team.
Your team sees this event, with their role and the time to reach.
Add your checklist in one tap.
Each step gets its own date, counted from the event.
Under For the client, add what you'll hand over, and by when.
When the client pays, tap Money received.
You always see what's paid and what's due.
To change anything, tap Edit dates and details.
After the event, tap Mark done.
Need help?
Open More, then Help, and watch this video again, any time.
